steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Science fiction is a genre that explores imagined futures, alternative realities and the consequences of scientific and technological advancement. | Key Fact: Core sci-fi themes include the relationship between humanity and technology, encounters with the alien or other, dystopian societies and the limits of knowledge. | Key Fact: Sci-fi iconography includes spaceships, futuristic cityscapes, advanced technology interfaces, alien creatures, robots and space suits. | Key Fact: Sci-fi settings range from deep space and alien planets to near-future Earth, dystopian cities and virtual reality environments.
